name: Allcargo Terminals Ltd
title: Allcargo Terminals Ltd - 543954 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: CFS/ICD operator in capacity-build mode: FY26 volume 723,035 TEUs (+6%), EBITDA +26%, with Farrukhnagar PFT-ICD and ~INR400cr capex plan; EBITDA/TEU ~INR2,300-2,400 held, no capacity-cut signal.

capex.quote: we are looking for INR400 crores capex spend for various expansion projects we are talking about

triggers.label: Capex ~INR400cr expansion plan
triggers.quote: we are looking for INR400 crores capex spend for various expansion projects

triggers.label: EBITDA/TEU ~INR2,300-2,400 held
triggers.quote: we will be happy to maintain our EBITDA per TEU at the levels that we currently are, which is about INR2,300 to INR2,400

triggers.label: 1 million TEU target FY28 reaffirmed
triggers.quote: we are on course to achieve the 1 million laden TEU number in FY28

triggers.label: Port congestion, transport shortage currently
triggers.quote: We are passing through one of them currently because of a bit of terminal congestion, shortage of transport fleet

guidance.value: 1 million laden TEUs in FY28; 1.25-1.3m by FY30 (capacity 12.5-13 lakh)
guidance.quote: we are on course to achieve the 1 million laden TEU number in FY28
our targeted EBITDA per TEU is in the range of INR2,200 to INR2,300
the time line for the PFT completion is April 2027 and the ICD completion, maybe another 2 quarters after that
the outgo for the year would be in the range of INR95 crores to INR100 crores

red_flags.label: Q4 margin spike attributed to lumpy other-expense reduction
red_flags.quote: Some of these expenses would come back and that's why I'm saying

red_flags.label: Ground rent share falling; dwell-time upside cited as commodity-driven
red_flags.quote: ground rent percentages have progressively come down

evasions.topic: Farrukhnagar volume ramp / 40% capacity utilisation estimate
evasions.quote: kindly consider this as a conservative estimate based upon the current market conditions
I would not want to make a comment on this today
I wouldn't have a specific date for that
